query:
SELECT 
  u.id as user_id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.role,
  u.custom_role_id,
  cr.name as custom_role_name
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN custom_roles cr ON u.custom_role_id = cr.id
WHERE u.role = 'manutencao' OR u.email LIKE '%manutencao%';
